title: 第十五章 天庭降神威 玉帝镇魔氛第十五章 瑞气归天地 玉影现千山
content_zh:
：灭世魔掌遮天压下，魔焰翻涌如狱，碾碎虚空，崩裂地脉，将四人牢牢困于绝境之中。七彩光墙裂痕遍布，莹白、银辉、翠绿、金赤四道本源之力日渐微弱，在滔天魔威之下，如同风中残烛，随时可能彻底熄灭。
四人皆是面色惨白，唇角鲜血不绝，周身经脉寸寸剧痛，神魂震颤欲裂，燃烧本源带来的反噬之力，席卷周身，每一分每一秒，都承受着焚身蚀骨之痛。可他们依旧死死咬牙，并肩而立，目光坚毅，没有一人退缩，没有一人屈服。
何年怀捧《六千字文》玉简，指尖已然泛白，周身时序道纹忽明忽暗，他已做好决绝之念，若光墙破碎，便引爆自身年神本源，以岁月道力禁锢魔主，为其余三人搏一线生机，护三界最后一丝正道气运。
何月素衣染血，月华本源熊熊燃烧，银辉渐渐黯淡，温婉的眉眼间，只剩赴死之坚定，她愿以自身月神魂飞魄散，换得苍生片刻安宁，绝不向邪魔低头。
花月初草木灵元近乎枯竭，翠绿灵韵愈发稀薄，周身生机渐散，却依旧将残存灵息尽数渡入光墙，以草木向生之道，硬抗魔主灭世之念，寸步不让。
何日骄阳神力近乎耗尽，金光黯淡无光，浑身气血翻涌，却依旧昂首挺胸，怒视云端魔主，满腔热血化作最后战意，纵使粉身碎骨，也要与邪魔血战到底。
灭世魔主立于魔云之巅，漆黑眸中满是漠然与嘲讽，看着下方苦苦支撑的四人，语气冰冷刺骨：“蝼蚁之力，也敢撼天？尔等坚守所谓正道，护所谓苍生，不过是自取灭亡。今日，本座便送你们归西，三界再无阻碍，乾坤由我掌控！”
话音落定，魔掌威压再增三分，魔焰滔天，彻底吞噬四方光芒，七彩光墙轰然一声，碎裂出一道巨大缺口，无边魔焰顺着缺口汹涌而入，直扑四人面门。
死亡的气息，瞬间笼罩四人周身，神魂已然感受到被魔焰吞噬的剧痛，天地间的生机、气运、时序，尽数被魔威压制，三界仿佛即将迎来最终的沉沦。
“我等宁死，绝不屈服！”
四人齐声怒喝，声震四野，倾尽最后一丝神力，欲做最后一搏。
就在这千钧一发、魂飞魄散之际——
九天之上，陡然传来一声清亮悠远的仙乐，响彻天地，穿透层层魔云，驱散周遭死寂。紧接着，万道金色霞光，自九霄天庭倾泻而下，金光璀璨，祥瑞漫天，带着无上天庭的威严与正道浩然之气，硬生生将漫天魔焰逼退数尺。
霞光所过之处，魔氛溃散，空间归位，大地震颤渐停，原本濒临崩碎的天地规则，竟被这股祥瑞神威缓缓稳固，紊乱的时序，也稍稍平复。
灭世魔主眉头微蹙，抬头望向九霄，漆黑眸中闪过一丝忌惮，周身魔焰不自觉收敛几分，冷声道：“何方宵小，敢阻本座大事！”
未等其话音落下，九霄云端，仙云翻滚，仙鹤齐鸣，天兵天将分列两侧，金甲熠熠，神威凛凛，旌旗猎猎，遮天蔽日。众神簇拥之下，一道身着九龙帝袍、头戴通天玉冠的伟岸身影，缓步踏云而来，周身金光万道，瑞气千条，帝威浩荡，震慑三界，正是三界至尊，昊天玉皇大帝。
玉帝身后，紧随托塔李天王、哪吒三太子、四大天王、太白金星等天庭众神，个个神光环绕，法力高深，齐齐催动天庭正道神力，化作漫天仙光，与灭世魔主的滔天魔氛分庭抗礼，瞬间扭转天地局势。
方才还压得四人喘不过气的灭世魔威，在天庭帝威与众神神威之下，骤然被削弱大半，涌入的魔焰，被霞光尽数净化，碎裂的七彩光墙，也被仙光缓缓稳固。
四人紧绷的心神，瞬间一松，周身力道散尽，再也支撑不住，纷纷踉跄倒地，却依旧强撑着身躯，望向天际降临的天庭众神，眼中闪过一丝希冀与动容。
燃烧本源的剧痛、神力枯竭的疲惫、神魂受损的昏沉，一齐涌上心头，四人面色愈发惨白，却终究是逃过了魂飞魄散之劫。

玉帝立于九天仙云之上，垂眸俯瞰下方，目光扫过满地疮痍、魔氛滔天的广袤平原，又看向倒地重伤、气息微弱的年月日四神，帝颜微沉，语气威严，响彻天地：“魔主妄动，击碎时序玉璧，掀起三界浩劫，遣麾下魔众屠戮苍生、祸乱天地，违背天道，触犯天条，罪无可赦！”
“朕执掌三界，护佑苍生，镇乾坤秩序，定天地时序，岂能容你在此肆意妄为，覆灭三界生机！今日朕亲率天庭众神降临，便是要镇你魔氛，遏你浩劫，护三界正道，保苍生安宁！”
灭世魔主凝视着对面的玉帝，周身魔焰翻涌，戾气更盛，却也不敢贸然出手。他深知玉帝修为深不可测，执掌天庭三界，手握天道权柄，神威浩荡，加之天庭众神齐聚，即便自己魔功盖世，也难占绝对上风。
“昊天玉帝，你执掌天庭，固步自封，天地时序腐朽，三界气运倾颓，早已不配掌控乾坤！”灭世魔主厉声喝道，魔威与玉帝帝威隔空碰撞，“本座重塑乾坤，覆灭旧秩序，乃是顺应天道大势，你若执意阻拦，便是与天道为敌，今日之战，你未必能胜！”
“天道大势，在于苍生安宁，在于天地有序，而非你一己私欲的灭世之举！”玉帝神色威严，不容置疑，右手轻抬，天庭无上帝力凝聚掌心，金光化作一柄浩然天帝剑，剑刃璀璨，蕴含天道正气，直指灭世魔主，“魔主若执意执迷不悟，朕便亲自动手，将你镇压，永镇魔界，杜绝浩劫！”
话音未落，玉帝身后众神齐齐催动神力，仙光汇聚成海，与玉帝帝力相融，天地间正道神威暴涨，霞光万丈，彻底压制住魔氛，天地间重现光明，日月星辰重焕光辉，紊乱的时序渐渐平稳。
灭世魔主脸色阴沉似水，周身魔焰剧烈波动。他谋划万古，只为今日覆灭三界，可如今玉帝亲至，天庭众神齐聚，正道神力浩荡，自己即便全力一战，也只能是两败俱伤，非但无法斩杀四神、覆灭三界，反倒可能被玉帝趁机镇压，前功尽弃。
此刻，他麾下瘟魔、妖王、魔将皆已败退，无一人能前来助阵，孤身一人面对玉帝与天庭众神，毫无胜算。
且方才与四人对决，他虽占据上风，却也耗费了不少魔元，加之玉帝手握天道权柄，专克魔界邪祟，长久对战，自己必落下风。
心中思绪百转，灭世魔主眼中闪过一丝狠厉与不甘，却也知晓，今日绝非最佳动手时机，不宜久战，只能暂且退去，再谋后路。
他死死盯着天际玉帝，又看向下方重伤倒地的四人，咬牙冷声道：“昊天玉帝，今日算你走运，坏本座大事！但这三界浩劫，已然开启，天地时序，终将崩毁，本座不会就此罢休！”
“年月日四神，还有这花间灵仙，本座迟早会将他们斩尽杀绝，这三界乾坤，终究会是本座的囊中之物！今日暂且罢手，他日，本座必卷土重来，覆灭天庭，荡平三界，谁也无法阻拦！”
话音落下，灭世魔主不再迟疑，周身魔焰暴涨，化作一道漆黑魔虹，冲天而起，直冲苍穹裂缝而去。他挥手卷起漫天残余魔氛，不愿留下丝毫神力被天庭众神炼化，身形转瞬便要遁入魔界虚空。
“邪魔休走！”
哪吒三太子见状，脚踏风火轮，手持火尖枪，欲纵身追击，却被玉帝抬手拦下。
“陛下，为何不趁此机会，将这灭世魔主彻底镇压，以绝后患？”托塔李天王手持玲珑宝塔，面露不解，沉声问道。
玉帝目光深邃，望着魔主遁去的苍穹裂缝，缓缓摇头，语气威严道：“魔主底蕴深厚，此番虽暂退，却未伤及根本，强行追击，必会陷入魔界埋伏，天庭众神亦会损伤惨重。”
content_en:
: The world-destroying demonic palm covers the sky and presses down, the demonic flame surges like a prison, crushes the void, cracks the earth's veins, and traps the four people in a desperate situation. The colorful light wall is full of cracks, and the four original powers of white, silver, emerald green, and gold and red are getting weaker and weaker. Under the overwhelming demonic power, they are like candles in the wind and may be completely extinguished at any time.
All four of them looked pale, with blood pouring from the corners of their lips. The meridians all over their bodies were in severe pain, and their souls were shaking to the point of splitting. The backlash brought by the burning source swept across their bodies, and they were enduring the pain of burning their bodies and eroding their bones every minute and every second. But they still gritted their teeth and stood side by side with firm eyes. No one backed down or surrendered.
He Nian holds the jade slip of "Six Thousand Character Essay" in his arms, his fingertips have turned white, and the time lines all over his body are flickering on and off. He is ready to make a decisive decision. If the wall of light is broken, he will detonate his own Nian God's origin, use the power of time to imprison the devil, fight for the remaining three people's life, and protect the last trace of righteousness in the three realms.
He Yue's plain clothes were stained with blood, the source of the moonlight was blazing, and the silver glow gradually dimmed. Her gentle brows and eyes were filled with determination to die. She was willing to give up her moon soul to die in exchange for a moment of peace for the common people, and would never give in to the evil spirit.
At the beginning of the flowering month, the spiritual energy of plants and trees is almost exhausted, the green aura is getting thinner and thinner, and the vitality around the body is gradually dissipating. However, the remaining spiritual energy is still transferred into the light wall, using the way of vegetation to grow, resisting the devil's desire to destroy the world, and not giving in.
He Sun's divine power is almost exhausted, the golden light is dim, and blood is surging all over his body, but he still holds his head high and his chest high, glaring at the Demon Lord in the Cloud, and his blood is filled with the final fighting intention. Even if he is shattered into pieces, he will fight the evil to the end.
The World-Destroying Demon Lord stood on the top of the demonic cloud, his dark eyes full of indifference and ridicule. He looked at the four people struggling to support him below, and his tone was cold and biting: "How dare you shake the sky with the power of ants? You stick to the so-called right path and protect the so-called common people, but you are just asking for your own destruction. Today, I will send you back to the west. There will be no obstacles in the three realms, and the world is under my control!"
After the words were settled, the pressure of the demonic palm increased by another three points. The demonic flames surged into the sky, completely swallowing up the light from all directions. The colorful light wall shattered with a bang and opened a huge gap. The boundless demonic flames surged in along the gap and rushed towards the four people's faces.
The breath of death instantly enveloped the four people, and their souls were already feeling the severe pain of being swallowed by the demonic flames. The vitality, luck, and timing of the world were all suppressed by the demonic power. It seemed that the three realms were about to usher in the final fall.
"I would rather die than give in!"
The four people roared in unison, the sound shaking the surrounding areas, and they used their last ounce of divine power to make a last stand.
At this critical moment, when the soul is about to flee——
Above the nine heavens, a clear and distant sound of fairy music suddenly came, resounding throughout the world, penetrating through layers of demonic clouds, and dispelling the deathly silence around. Immediately afterwards, thousands of golden rays of light poured down from the Nine Heavens. The golden light was bright and auspicious, filling the sky with the majesty of the supreme heaven and the aura of the righteous way, forcefully forcing the demonic flames in the sky back several feet.
Wherever the rays of light passed, the demonic atmosphere collapsed, the space returned to its original position, and the tremors of the earth gradually stopped. The rules of heaven and earth that were originally on the verge of collapse were slowly stabilized by this auspicious divine power, and the chaotic time sequence was slightly calmed down.
The World-Destroying Demon Lord frowned slightly and raised his head to look up at the sky. A trace of fear flashed in his dark eyes. The demonic flames around him unconsciously restrained a bit, and he said in a cold voice: "How dare you, Xiao Fang, dare to hinder this important event of mine!"
Before he could finish his words, fairy clouds were billowing in the sky, cranes were singing in unison, heavenly soldiers and generals were arranged on both sides, their golden armors were shining, they were majestic, and they were hunting with flags, covering the sky and blocking out the sun. Surrounded by the gods, a majestic figure wearing a nine-dragon imperial robe and a sky-high jade crown came slowly on the clouds. He was surrounded by thousands of golden lights and thousands of auspicious auras. His imperial majesty shocked the three realms. He was none other than the Supreme of the Three Realms, the Haotian Jade Emperor.
Behind the Jade Emperor, followed closely by King Li Tianwang of Tota, Third Prince Nezha, the Four Heavenly Kings, Taibai Jinxing and other heavenly gods, all surrounded by divine light and with profound magic power. They all activated the righteous divine power of heaven, turned into fairy light all over the sky, and fought with the world-destroying demon.The Lord's monstrous demonic atmosphere stood up to the enemy and instantly reversed the situation in the world.
The world-destroying demonic power that had just overwhelmed the four of them was suddenly weakened by half under the power of the Heavenly Emperor and the gods. The influx of demonic flames was completely purified by the rays of light, and the broken colorful wall of light was slowly stabilized by the fairy light.
The tense minds of the four people relaxed in an instant. All the strength in their bodies was gone. They could no longer hold up. They stumbled to the ground one after another, but they still held on to their bodies and looked at the gods descending from the sky. A trace of hope and emotion flashed in their eyes.
The severe pain of burning the source, the exhaustion of depleted divine power, and the lethargy of damaged souls all came to their hearts. The four people's faces became increasingly pale, but they finally escaped the disaster of losing their souls.
The Jade Emperor stood on the Nine Heavens Immortal Cloud, looking down below. His eyes swept across the vast plains covered with devastation and filled with demonic atmosphere. He then looked at the four gods of year, month and sun who fell to the ground with serious injuries and weak breaths. The emperor's face sank slightly. The tone was majestic, resounding throughout the world: "The Demon Lord acted rashly, shattered the Jade of Time, caused catastrophe in the three realms, sent the demons under his command to slaughter the people, bring disaster to the world, violate the laws of heaven, violate the laws of heaven, the crime is unpardonable!"
"I am in charge of the three realms, protect the common people, maintain the order of the universe, and determine the time sequence of the heaven and earth. How can I allow you to act recklessly here and destroy the vitality of the three realms! Today, I personally lead the gods from heaven to come to suppress your demonic atmosphere, contain your catastrophe, protect the righteousness of the three realms, and protect the peace of the common people!"
The World-Destroying Demon Lord stared at the Jade Emperor opposite, with demonic flames surging all over his body and becoming more violent, but he did not dare to take action rashly. He knew that the Jade Emperor's cultivation was unfathomable, that he controlled the three realms of heaven, held the power of heaven, and had great power. In addition, all the gods in heaven gathered together, so even if he had unparalleled magic power, he would still have difficulty gaining the absolute upper hand.
"Haotian Jade Emperor, you are in charge of the Heavenly Court and are stuck in your own way. The time order of heaven and earth is rotten, and the luck of the three realms is declining. You are no longer worthy of controlling the world!" The World-Destroying Demon Lord shouted sharply, and the demonic power collided with the power of the Jade Emperor. "I am reshaping the world and destroying the old order in line with the general trend of heaven. If you insist on blocking it, you are an enemy of heaven. You may not be able to win today's battle!"
"The general trend of heaven lies in the peace of the people and the order of heaven and earth, not in your selfish desire to destroy the world!" The Jade Emperor's expression was majestic, leaving no room for doubt. He raised his right hand lightly, and the heavenly power gathered in his palm, golden The light turned into an awe-inspiring Heavenly Emperor Sword. The blade was bright, containing the righteousness of heaven, and pointed directly at the demon lord who destroyed the world. "If the demon lord persists in his stubbornness, I will personally suppress you, suppress the demon world forever, and prevent catastrophe!"
Before he finished speaking, all the gods behind the Jade Emperor mobilized their divine power. The fairy light gathered into a sea and merged with the power of the Jade Emperor. The power of the righteous path between heaven and earth surged, and the rays of light completely suppressed the demonic atmosphere. Light reappeared in the sky and earth, the sun, moon and stars regained their brilliance, and the chaotic time sequence gradually stabilized.
The face of the World-Destroying Demon Lord was as gloomy as water, and the demonic flames around his body fluctuated violently. He planned for eternity just to destroy the three realms today, but now that the Jade Emperor has arrived, all the gods in heaven have gathered together, and the righteousness is so powerful, even if he fights with all his strength, he will only lose both sides. Not only will he be unable to kill the four gods and destroy the three realms, but he may be suppressed by the Jade Emperor, and all his previous efforts will be wasted.
At this moment, all the plague demons, demon kings, and demon generals under his command have been defeated, and no one can come to help. He faces the Jade Emperor and the gods in heaven alone, with no chance of winning.
Moreover, in the duel with four people just now, although he had the upper hand, he also spent a lot of demonic energy. In addition, the Jade Emperor holds the power of heaven and specializes in defeating the evil spirits of the demon world. If he fights for a long time, he will definitely fall behind.
Thoughts were swirling in his mind, and a trace of fierceness and unwillingness flashed in the eyes of the World-Destroying Demon Lord, but he also knew that today was by no means the best time to take action, and it was not advisable to fight for a long time. He could only retreat temporarily and find a way out.
He stared at the Jade Emperor of Tianji, then looked at the four people who were seriously injured and fell to the ground below. He gritted his teeth and said coldly: "Haotian Jade Emperor, today you are lucky to have ruined my big event! But the catastrophe of the three realms has already begun, and the time sequence of heaven and earth will eventually collapse. I will not let it go!"
"The four gods of year, month and day, and this fairy among the flowers,Sooner or later, I will kill them all. These three realms will eventually be in my possession! Let's give up for now. One day, I will come back with a vengeance, destroy the heaven, and level the three realms. No one can stop me! "
After the words fell, the World-Destroying Demon Lord no longer hesitated. The demonic flames around him surged and turned into a dark demonic rainbow, soaring into the sky and heading straight towards the cracks in the sky. He waved his hand to roll up the remaining demonic atmosphere that filled the sky, not wanting to leave any trace of his divine power to be refined by the gods in heaven. In an instant, he was about to escape into the void of the demonic world.
"Stop the devil! "
Upon seeing this, the third prince Nezha stepped on the hot wheel and held a fire-pointed spear. He wanted to pursue him, but the Jade Emperor raised his hand to stop him.
"Your Majesty, why don't you take this opportunity to completely suppress this world-destroying demon lord to avoid future troubles? "Pagoda King Li Tian asked in a deep voice with a puzzled expression on his face, holding the exquisite pagoda.
The Jade Emperor's eyes were deep, looking at the crack in the sky where the Demon Lord escaped, he slowly shook his head, and said in a majestic tone: "The Demon Lord has a profound background. Although he retreated temporarily, he did not damage the foundation. If he pursues forcefully, he will surely fall into an ambush in the Demon Realm, and the gods in heaven will also suffer heavy damage. "
